title: ChroPack - IMAC Protein Purification Protocol
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.72hhqb6
materials: Prepare Buffers: Wash Buffer: 0.05 Molarity (M), Sodium dihydrogen phosphate 8 Molarity (M), Urea 0.3 Molarity (M), Sodium chloride adjust to pH 8.0 with NaOH Elution Buffer: 0.05 Molarity (M), Sodium dihydrogen phosphate 8 Molarity (M), Urea .3 Molarity (M), Sodium chloride 0.25 Molarity (M), Imidazole adjust to pH 8.0 with NaOH
6 M Guanidine chloride, 0.2 M Acetic acid Cleaning solution
1 % Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) Cleaning solution 3: > 95 % Ethanol Cleaning solution
0.2 M Acetic Acid Metal solution: 0.1 M Nickel(II) sulfate (or other metal ion of your choice) 20 % (v/v) Ethanol

Solutions needed: Deionized water Cleaning solution 1: 6 M Guanidine chloride, 0.2 M Acetic acid Cleaning solution 2: 1 % Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) Cleaning solution 3: > 95 % Ethanol Cleaning solution 4: 0.1 M Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) Cleaning solution 5: 0.2 M Acetic Acid Metal solution: 0.1 M Nickel(II) sulfate (or other metal ion of your choice) 20 % (v/v) Ethanol

steps.title: Weigh, thaw, and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Determine the weight of the frozen bacterial pellet, thaw at room temperature, and resuspend in wash buffer by pipetting using 3–5 mL buffer per gram of pellet. Add lysozyme and DNase I each to a final concentration of 0.1 mg mL⁻¹. Pre‑chill the centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate lysate with enzymes
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended pellet for 15 min with gentle end‑over‑end mixing, stirring, or rocking at room temperature, or for 30 min at 4–8 °C if the target protein is prone to proteolysis or denaturation.

steps.title: Filter lysate
steps.instruction: Filter the cleared lysate through a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Connect column and initial wash
steps.instruction: Connect the IMAC column to the FPLC system, set flow rate to 1 bed volume min⁻¹, wash with 5 column volumes (CV) deionized water, pump 0.5 CV of a nickel or cobalt solution (other options: Cu²⁺ or Zn²⁺), then wash with an additional 5 CV deionized water.

steps.title: Equilibrate column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the column with 5–10 CV of wash buffer.

steps.title: Load cleared lysate
steps.instruction: Load the filtered lysate onto the equilibrated column.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 10–20 CV of wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute protein
steps.instruction: Elute bound protein with 10 CV of elution buffer, collecting fractions of 0.5–1 CV each.

steps.title: Post‑purification column wash and storage
steps.instruction: Wash the column sequentially with 5 CV elution buffer, 5 CV wash buffer, and 5 CV deionized water. Then wash with either 5 CV 20 % (v/v) ethanol or 5 CV wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide. Close the top lid and bottom stopper and store the column at room temperature or 4–8 °C.

steps.title: Flush column with water
steps.instruction: Connect the column to the FPLC system and flush with 5 CV deionized water at 1 BV min⁻¹.

steps.title: Apply cleaning solutions
steps.instruction: For cleaning solutions 1 through 5, pump 5 CV of each solution sequentially, washing with 10 CV deionized water between each cleaning solution.

steps.title: Final metal re‑equilibration and water wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 5 CV deionized water, then pump 1 CV of the metal solution (Ni²⁺ or Co²⁺), and finally wash with 10 CV deionized water.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and store column
steps.instruction: Pump 5 CV of 20 % (v/v) ethanol, disconnect the column, close it, and store at 4 °C or room temperature.

steps.title: Sanitization flush sequence
steps.instruction: Connect the column, flush with 5 CV water, then with elution buffer and wash buffer (without urea) at 1 BV min⁻¹.

steps.title: Final ethanol flush and storage
steps.instruction: Flush the column with 5 CV sanitization solution, stop the pump and wait 1 hour; then flush with 5 CV 20 % (v/v) ethanol, disconnect, close, and store at 4 °C or room temperature.
